scope: Cancellation while a real client pauses reads: observe a held Closing window after KILL returns with Client released, full row plus ERR1317 and native same-socket reuse; incomplete large row emits a positive wire prefix, physically closes the socket and refuses a zero-response follow-up without new BE tasks. KILL start/return/resume times are recorded; the 2s post-KILL observation is not the production 5s Closing deadline origin. Excludes explicit framing cursor/tail bytes proof, full pools, ACK-only and allocator exit.
